# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c16 P44](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v4 c23 P15](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Sawmill operator and sailor  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Rufus Vane was a large, good-looking man possessing a fair, flushed complexion and hazel eyes, having one blue eye and one hazel eye due to a family trait. Following his injury, he grew severely overweight, stocky, and wore a large beard.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P34](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0034), [v4 c14 P15](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0015)_

## Personality

Rufus Vane had a small, wicked, and selfish nature, being a heavy drinker and a man of little principle. He possessed a fierce, possessive, and jealous streak, forcing his demands and becoming ill-tempered or violent when crossed. After incurring a severe brain injury, his personality changed into that of a simple, helpless, and generally gentle child who was easily managed, though he occasionally suffered from bad-tempered periods or bouts of stubbornness.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c14 P15](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0015)_

## Traits

- Small, wicked, and selfish nature  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Heavy drinker  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Jealous and possessive  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c14 P15](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0015)</sub>
- Childlike and simple-minded after his injury  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## Abilities

- Operating a small sawmill  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Sailing  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Lorna Ainslie by forcing her consent through financial blackmail  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane operated a small sawmill up river and resided in a desolate clearing surrounded by stumps. He married Lorna Ainslie after coercing her into the union by threatening to foreclose on her widowed mother's farm mortgage. During their marriage, his household took in the orphan Nell Harcourt for over two years to help care for their eight young children, including three sets of twins. After Rufus passed away, his household was dissolved and his children were distributed among family members, leading Nell to be sent to the Marden asylum. It was later revealed that Rufus had sailed to Cuba on the Four Sisters, contracted yellow fever, and died there thirteen years prior to the events at Seven Gulls; the man who had returned to Seven Gulls in his place and lived under his name as an invalid for eleven years was actually his cousin, Laurence Vane.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c23 P15](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Was the son of storekeeper Abner Vane and operated a small clearing sawmill up river  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Had eight children, including three consecutive sets of twins, with his wife  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Forced Lorna Ainslie into marriage by threatening to foreclose on her family farm's mortgage  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Contracted yellow fever in Cuba and died shortly after sailing on the Four Sisters  <sub>[v4 c23 P15](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0015)</sub>
